scope: Current-task autonomous coverage and defect recovery; does not dispatch B19 or certify full-system release.
execution: sequential one writer; no subagents or background implementation workers

domains.name: Launch/navigation/configuration
scenarioFamilies: all registered visible entries and guarded hidden routes
domains.acceptance: Expected route/state, actionable failure, no lost session or inaccessible recovery.

domains.name: Vocabulary and content
scenarioFamilies: starter data immutable; category deletion scoped
domains.acceptance: Exact row/value changes and owner isolation; no duplicate side effects.

domains.name: All learning modes
scenarioFamilies: derive exact mode inventory from registry
configured1 with meaningful distractors and shortage recovery
domains.acceptance: Expected feedback and exact evidence/reward deltas; guided/replay actions never create independent evidence improperly.

domains.name: Reading and pedagogical content
scenarioFamilies: all6associative stages preserve actual passage and required inputs
single-choice and list-like-story findings investigated against content contracts
domains.acceptance: Content present and internally consistent; automated checks do not certify language level or teaching effectiveness.

domains.name: SRS/time/progress
domains.acceptance: Reference schedule and evidence counts match; fake clock only in fixture, phone wall clock unchanged.

domains.name: Rewards/quests/shop
scenarioFamilies: concurrent duplicate commands at repository boundary
domains.acceptance: Ledger reconciles opening+earned-spent=closing; one transaction per logical action.

domains.name: Planning/preferences/assessment/offline
scenarioFamilies: test-only feature composition exercises create/edit/cancel/reopen goals/plans
assessment isolation and synthetic consent gating
domains.acceptance: Production defaults unchanged; fixtures prove domain/UI behavior only, no live study enrollment or rollout.

domains.name: Identity/storage/migration
scenarioFamilies: deletion only for explicitly created disposable test data
domains.acceptance: Owner A cannot read/write/delete B; migrated data preserves declared invariants; existing user sessions untouched.

domains.name: Network and sync
scenarioFamilies: process death with pending queue,conflict and isolation
domains.acceptance: Queue converges exactly once with durable restart; real hosted sync remains separate acceptance.

domains.name: AI/login orchestration
scenarioFamilies: reuse unchanged login evidence with identity/date
local fake provider cancellation,expired session,quota denial,timeout,malformed output
late reply after owner switch/background and tool/RPC rejection
verify no paid/live outbound call in autonomous fixture
domains.acceptance: State recovery/isolation under simulated provider; no claim of working inference or guaranteed provider billing.

domains.name: Speech/audio
scenarioFamilies: real device permission denial,granted,silence,cancel,background and retry
known audio files through accessible offline decoding/scoring interfaces
local TTS invocation/completion and resource release
simulate service missing/error and audio interruption at app boundary
domains.acceptance: Native lifecycle separately evidenced from injected waveform tests; microphone recognition/hearing quality remains external when no verified unattended audio path exists.

domains.name: Camera/model
scenarioFamilies: real pinned model on rights-cleared labeled known/unknown images
domains.acceptance: Report model metrics separately from live-camera capture; held-out set frozen before run,no tuning on it; no web-image score substitutes for camera accuracy.

domains.name: Exports
scenarioFamilies: reconcile all58manifest groups and metadata-only/redacted exclusions
picker cancel/write failure/restart and partial-file cleanup
Anki import in isolated test profile only if compatible runtime available
domains.acceptance: Expected fields,counts,hashes and rendered text match independent expectations; TSV validity alone is not Anki import success.

domains.name: Accessibility/layout
scenarioFamilies: pair board semantics with production widget integration driver
domains.acceptance: Semantic and visual checks pass on tested configurations; human TalkBack usability not inferred.

domains.name: Resilience/performance/endurance
scenarioFamilies: process death at owned transaction checkpoints
repeated mode switches/cancel/resume/export and resource release
frame times,RSS,CPU,thermal/battery observations and bounded logs
domains.acceptance: Real elapsed time required; no crash/ANR/data mismatch; budgets pinned before run,charging bias disclosed; no human dependency for unattended soak.

domains.name: Final integrated journeys and evidence closure
scenarioFamilies: same journey after restart and local-sync failures
release-sha integration only when repository freeze gate permits
cleanup/process inventory/package/source provenance and final open-defect review
domains.acceptance: All applicable declared assertions evidenced with exact source/artifact; no unresolved mandatory defects or undocumented omissions.

phases.deliverable: Inventory and reconcile current versus historical evidence; map every registry entry/requirement to a case or justified exclusion.
Build safe disposable-owner fixture and state-aware driver; verify startup/cleanup/owner fences before destructive synthetic cases.
Independent rule/repository references, fake clock and local-service faults; bounded tests per affected subsystem.
Sequential real-Vivo native and fixture journeys; record exact data side effects,not merely taps/screens.
Reproduce and fix each product defect with RED/GREEN then physical retest; runner failures repaired separately.
Pinned-budget performance and real180minute endurance on stable source; reusable checkpoints and meaningful progress.
Reconcile required case closure,artifacts,data/process cleanup; publish explicit autonomous and external coverage denominators.

coveragePolicy: Do not invent total case count before inventory; report passed/required separately per evidence level and domain. Hidden features remain in denominator; historical fingerprint mismatch is STALE. No multiplied Cartesian count presented as meaningful coverage.
externalAcceptance: Real provider inference/entitlement/quota-only assurance and live revoke
Production hosted account sync and service configuration
New independent held-out physical camera scenes
Actual Anki import if no compatible isolated runtime
notExternalBlockers: SRS due data and day boundaries
Hidden feature domain/UI under test-only composition
recovery: Stop failed method,inspect evidence,correct runner/fixture/product and retest affected cases;never weaken acceptance or promote simulated evidence. Continue independent authorized work while genuine external prerequisites remain.
